title: Native Windows Staging broker host bootstrap with fail-closed installation authority

phases.objective: Provide a native Windows SCM service skeleton and bounded Staging-only installation plan that cannot grant DBA authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Build a credential-free ServiceBase host and verify the elevated-only installer guards.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Native host compiles and selftests; non-admin installation stops before any OS mutation; no DBA or Production authority is generated.
steps: Compile native ServiceBase host with built-in Windows compiler, without a third-party unsigned wrapper.
Verify signed-out source SHA, executable hash, default read-only installer and exact deployment certification.
Reject unauthorized interactive execution and unprivileged Windows service installation.
Require explicit Staging-only inert service scope and protected virtual service identity for future admin operation.
Do not open database, network or cryptographic operations in the inert ServiceBase class.
assertions: Native code contains no network/DB/filesystem writes or handler for signed operation tickets.
Installer checks exact main/source/deployed in-container SHA, binary digest and elevation before modifying the OS.
No automatic GitHub source code approval can authorize a DBA operation or backup/restore.
Staging service bootstrap and tests cannot mutate Production or grant DBA.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Detect an interrupted virtual-service registration and run exact-source, no-DB recovery guards.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Omit the empty native password argument, report sanitized SCM registration failure codes, require explicitly authorized single-binary recovery, and reject all non-admin execution before OS writes.
steps: Omit PowerShell 5.1 password= empty argument when registering the NT SERVICE virtual account.
Preserve native SCM failure exit and sanitized Win32 status.
Refuse recovery unless a separate explicit switch and exact copied EXE SHA-256, one-file content and protected SYSTEM/Administrators ACL agree.
Enforce exact GitHub main, deployed Staging source, in-container manifest, OS elevation, inert-only operation scope before changes.
Keep all DBA, backup/restore and Production operations out of the inert service host.
assertions: No empty password= native argument is passed to sc.exe on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Interrupted registration fails closed for unverified content, ACL or binary hash.
Unprivileged apply cannot mutate service or installation directory.
No SQL or Production mutation authorization is introduced.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging Windows operator and offline CI auditor
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only elevated inspect of already registered inert Broker service on the exact certified Staging release.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exact OS path, SHA256, PID, virtual identity, SID type and protected three-principal ACL are measured without grants; independently signed and operational authority remain false.
steps: Check actual Administrator token and exact Staging source certification before protected reads.
Read service and process identity from Windows CIM and reject mismatched SCM binary path, reparse points and SHA-256.
Require protected directory DACL and exact SYSTEM/Admin full control plus virtual service RX; inspect file DACL.
Report only bounded, unsigned noncredential evidence and retain explicit denial of independent signing, DBA, backup, restore and Production privileges.
assertions: Non-elevated execution is denied before accessing protected installed binary or ACL.
No service, filesystem, Docker, database or credential mutation occurs.
Unsigned OS readback is never treated as operational certification or an independent signed attestation.
Existing deployed/certified Staging exact source remains an explicit prerequisite.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging audit-verifier developer without trusted signer custody
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Validate detached Ed25519 evidence using in-memory ephemeral test keys and a trusted-expectations argument.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Cryptographic signature and exact evidence-bound assertions validate, but independent pinned-key custody, replay registry, immutable audit and operational grant all remain denied.
steps: Generate an ephemeral Ed25519 test key in CI memory without persisting a private key.
Sign canonical domain-separated payload bound to Staging exact SHA, installed executable digest, nonce and OS evidence.
Reject substitutions to key, signature, schema, timestamp, nonce, host, account, hash, ACL and false authority flags.
Report successful cryptographic verification with blocked external trust/custody and immutable-audit gates.
Never create credentials, authorize one-shot DBA operations, execute Backup/Restore or mutate Production.
assertions: Signed payload bytes must be canonical and Ed25519 SPKI pin fingerprint must match.
No caller-controlled pin or JSON field can independently certify Broker or authorize DBA.
Unissued nonce, replay, stale or future timestamps are refused as cryptographic binding failures.
Even a syntactically and cryptographically valid signature is not an externally custodied trusted attestation.

e2e_journeys.actor: offline Staging audit verifier without independent custodian
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Validate signed OS evidence and a separately signed, domain-separated audit witness receipt using in-memory synthetic keys.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both mathematical signatures and exact source/executable/nonce/digest bindings verified with 21 adversarial cases; no external custody, replay, immutable audit or operational authority declared.
steps: Generate two distinct ephemeral Ed25519 test keys in memory without persisting signing secrets.
Check domain-separated canonical OS evidence with exact Staging SHA, executable digest and challenge nonce.
Independently verify witness receipt signature with second key against signer digest, OS-evidence hash, nonce and staging SHA.
Reject forged authority, incorrect key, swapped hash, stale/future timestamps, altered receipts and noncanonical signed bytes.
Report cryptographic consistency while retaining all independent authority/replay/audit/DBA/Backup/Restore/Production blockers.
assertions: Two signatures must be distinct, valid and unambiguously bound to the same Staging OS evidence.
Extra fields claiming independently custodied audit or operational DBA authority must fail closed.
Synthetic verification must never clear live Trust Readiness blockers or authorize data operations.
No key or secret persistence, network access or database mutation by the receipt verifier.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows/Staging isolated OS challenge coordinator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Open separately protected directory and issue random 256-bit Staging-only challenge, then consume exactly once.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One process claims nonce; seven concurrent processes and post-restart replay are blocked by atomic persistent file markers. External independent challenge ownership is still unverified.
steps: Require preprovisioned private Staging-only directory and separately measured ACL, revalidating before every issue/consume.
Generate 256-bit random challenge bound to exact certified Git SHA, executable SHA256, expiry.
Atomically write+fsync issued challenge, then validate exact issue record and create consumed marker with exclusive creation and fsync.
Race eight separate OS Node processes, simulate restart, deny reused/expired/forged and out-of-scope challenges.
Never authorize operational service or database changes merely from a successful local replay check.
assertions: Exactly one concurrent process consumes challenge, even across isolated process boundaries.
Consumed marker persists and is rejected on restart; no deletion/rewinding of records.
Changing expected Staging SHA, measured binary hash, expiry, issued nonce, or scope fails closed.
Local ledger cannot be represented as externally immutable audit or independent custody.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging isolated OS key verifier without independent out-of-band owner anchor
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read pre-existing protected Staging registry of two public Ed25519 keys using a separately supplied SHA256 digest.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Canonical owner and witness public keys read only if file hash, scope, key type, identities, directory/file permissions match. Independent root custody remains denied.
steps: Require an exact protected Staging registry path and an expected digest obtained via independent channel.
Verify hash of full bytes and strict schema, exact Staging environment and device.
Verify two distinct Ed25519 SPKI public keys and their fingerprints; reject swapped, duplicate, tampered, Production and overprivileged manifests.
Never create private signing keys, install an Operator authority or grant DBA based only on a caller-provided registry digest.
assertions: Public key readback rejects tampered files and mismatched expected hash.
Two distinct signer roles required, with no private keys persisted.
Missing independently approved anchor, external immutable storage and owner one-shot permission remain hard blocked.

e2e_journeys.actor: Offline Staging external audit verifier, without independent provider credentials
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Validate separately signed OS/witness chain plus provider-signed retention claim against exact canonical witness bytes read back from purported external storage.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Three distinct Ed25519 signatures and exact Staging/source/nonce/object/content/retention claim consistent, 22 integrity and authority-spoofing cases denied; actual provider WORM remains unverified and trust gates blocked.
steps: Generate three ephemeral test-only signing keys: OS, witness and independent provider role.
Verify original signed OS evidence, separately signed witness and domain-separated signed provider retention claim.
Compare entire stored witness-envelope bytes with exactly expected canonical envelope and provider key/object/version/retention bindings.
Reject wrong source, nonce, binary, provider key, object path, content digest, short retention, old/future claims, signature forgery and authority injection.
Always deny external WORM certification and DBA/Backup/Restore operational authority until genuinely independent provider readback and retention evidence exist.
assertions: Provider receipt signature and Staging witness chain are mathematically valid but not evidence of an independently authenticated WORM service.
No caller-provided retention_mode=COMPLIANCE or claim booleans can clear WORM/independent custody blockers.
No real provider credentials, network requests, DB mutations, production changes or key installation.
The source test must include at least 22 negative cases and keep Broker operation denied.
